props.animation_script:
// @desc Laser Eyes: red laser beam from caster to each target (up to 2) + laser sfx (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

beamUrl: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Ranged/LaserShot_01_Regular_Red_30ft_1600x400.webm",

fireSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Laser1.ogg",

volume: 0.8,

thickness: 0.7, // beam height as a fraction of caster token height

hitDelayMs: 260, // when the beam "lands" (fire the damage gate)

tailMs: 650, // let the beam finish visually after impact

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const targets = oni.targets || [];

if (!caster || !targets.length) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95000 });

oni.sfx(cfg.fireSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

for (const target of targets) {

const dx = target.center.x - caster.center.x;

const dy = target.center.y - caster.center.y;

const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;

const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

const media = oni.webmSprite(cfg.beamUrl, { parent: layer });

const spr = media.sprite;

spr.anchor.set(0.02, 0.5);

spr.position.set(caster.center.x, caster.center.y);

spr.rotation = ang;

spr.width = dist;

spr.height = Math.max(56, caster.h * cfg.thickness);

}

await oni.wait(cfg.hitDelayMs);

oni.fireDone();

await oni.wait(cfg.tailMs);

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/olmek-laser-eyes",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.hitDelayMs + 4000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

// @desc Stone Gaze: large dark-green eye overlay at screen center + darkness sfx (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

eyeUrl: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Eyes/Eyes_Single01_03_Dark_Green_300x300.webm",

sfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness3.ogg",

volume: 0.85,

sizeFrac: 0.66, // eye size as a fraction of screen height (large)

fadeInMs: 340,

holdMs: 620,

fadeOutMs: 360,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 97000 });

const s = oni.screen();

const media = oni.webmSprite(cfg.eyeUrl, { parent: layer });

const spr = media.sprite;

const c = s.S2W(0.5, 0.5);

spr.position.set(c.x, c.y);

spr.width = spr.height = s.hPx(cfg.sizeFrac);

spr.alpha = 0;

oni.sfx(cfg.sfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.fadeInMs, ease: oni.EASE.outQuad, onUpdate: (v) => (spr.alpha = v) });

oni.fireDone();

await oni.wait(cfg.holdMs);

await oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.fadeOutMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad, onUpdate: (v) => (spr.alpha = v) });

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/olmek-stone-gaze",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.fadeInMs + 4000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Shatter: shrapnel burst on each PETRIFIED target + earth sfx (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

burstUrl: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Explosion/ShrapnelBomb01_01_Regular_Black_800x800.webm",

sfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Earth1.ogg",

volume: 0.85,

scale: 2.0, // burst size = target width * this

petrifyStatusId: "qePlOECBTS0Dftgc",

hitDelayMs: 240, // when the shatter "lands" (fire the execute)

shakeMs: 360, shakeIntensity: 8,

tailMs: 700,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const targets = oni.targets || [];

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

const isPetrified = (t) => {

const a = t.actor; if (!a) return false;

try { if (a.statuses && a.statuses.has(cfg.petrifyStatusId)) return true; } catch (e) {}

try { for (const e of a.effects) if (e.name === 'Petrify') return true; } catch (e) {}

return false;

};

const petr = targets.filter(isPetrified);

if (!petr.length) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

oni.sfx(cfg.sfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

for (const t of petr) {

const media = oni.webmSprite(cfg.burstUrl, { parent: layer });

media.sprite.position.set(t.center.x, t.center.y);

media.sprite.width = media.sprite.height = t.w * cfg.scale;

}

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeIntensity });

await oni.wait(cfg.hitDelayMs);

oni.fireDone();

await oni.wait(cfg.tailMs);

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/olmek-shatter",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.hitDelayMs + 4000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();
